t.zh: 第 0 章的机器算得出任意多项，可它只会加和乘：从整数出发，算出来的永远是整数。1, 1/2, 1/3, … 这样越来越小的数列，它一项也算不出。
t.en: Chapter 0’s machine computes as many terms as asked, but it only adds and multiplies: starting from whole numbers, everything it makes is whole. A shrinking sequence like 1, 1/2, 1/3, … is out of its reach, term by term.

t.zh: 这一章的第一件新元件是<part-ref to="part:recip"></part-ref>：给出 1/a。
t.en: The chapter’s first new part is <part-ref to="part:recip"></part-ref>: it gives 1/a.

after.zh: 1/(n+1) 每一项都不是 0，却能小过任何给定的正数。
after.en: No term of 1/(n+1) is 0, yet it gets smaller than any positive number you name.

hint.en: The index is 0 on the first tick.
